usefulness_review.scope: Independent review of all15 source snippets; separate from numeric correctness and capability coverage.
usefulness_review.interpretation: Actionable means a concrete source-driven review candidate, not a demonstrated bug or an authorized implementation. Context-only means effects are coherent with the visible role; it is not a claim that the diagnostic is numerically false. Uncertain means helper/callback/instrumentation contracts are needed to judge refactoring usefulness.
usefulness_review.recommendation_limits: No algorithm edits, threshold increases, suppressions, policy changes, replacement hashes or extra proofs proposed. Density alone does not establish that an extraction improves the code.

cases.source_rationale: Coordinates node effect installation, definition-ID registration, PDG definition insertion and location insertion. install_effect can mutate the node before the later duplicate-ID check returns Err.
cases.useful_review_or_separation: A useful review seam is validation/preparation followed by commit of the coordinated node/definition/location updates. This follows the independently fallible update order, rather than the mutation count.
cases.limits: Whether partial state survives Err depends on caller ownership/rollback. The source alone does not establish a bug or justify a new transactional abstraction.

cases.source_rationale: Already a narrow installer: resolves one serialized node, installs its read/annotation payload and returns leftover locations. The writes implement a single node update.
cases.useful_review_or_separation: No useful further separation is established by this source; the resolver/installer seam already exists.
cases.limits: Borrowing node mutably is an expected part of the operation, not independent evidence of architectural coupling.

cases.source_rationale: get_mut performs lazy Entry-to-Json normalization in place, then returns the mutable JSON payload. Replacement and reassignment serve one representation transition.
cases.useful_review_or_separation: Treat the finding as context about a mutating accessor; extracting its few writes would not remove the conversion responsibility.
cases.limits: The lazy accessor contract may deserve documentation, but changing it requires caller/API evidence absent here.

cases.source_rationale: Locates one census entry, interns its shared owner with the supplied owners collection, and installs the interned value. This is inherently coordination between an entry and its owner table.
cases.useful_review_or_separation: The existing intern_owner helper already separates interning from entry lookup/assignment.
cases.limits: Failure behavior inside intern_owner is outside this snippet; a numerical finding alone does not establish another refactor.

cases.source_rationale: certify is a short staged orchestrator over activation, production, derivation and diagnostic observation. There is no direct mutable state in its signature or visible body.
cases.useful_review_or_separation: Before proposing separation, distinguish helper work and diagnostic instrumentation from changes to the certification result. Existing production/derivation seams are visible.
cases.limits: Usefulness of a propagated density finding cannot be determined from this wrapper alone; no effect category or finding detail was used in this judgment.

cases.source_rationale: unpack validates recursion/index structure, loads one node, records it as used, charges bounded work and delegates decoding. The used set and budget are reader invariants.
cases.useful_review_or_separation: The existing value decoder already separates decoding from node admission/accounting.
cases.limits: Splitting accounting solely to reduce a score could obscure the single-node reader invariant; no additional source-driven seam is established.

cases.source_rationale: value dispatches transport tags and charges literal data; encoded strings and collections already have separate handlers. Stateful budget use is part of bounded decoding.
cases.useful_review_or_separation: The source shows a clear dispatch boundary, so a density finding is primarily context about decoder effects.
cases.limits: The presence of a literal branch and stateful child handlers does not by itself justify a parallel decoder or additional abstraction.

cases.source_rationale: collection dispatches array, text and object formats, invoking recursive child decoding. The branches already delegate specialized behavior.
cases.useful_review_or_separation: Treat recursive state/budget use as expected for a bounded deserializer; no useful further separation is apparent.
cases.limits: Source alone does not imply that all collection handlers should be pure or that extracted helpers would improve the design.

cases.source_rationale: begin_module sets the enum namespace before computing fallible inherited definitions and scope. A failure can leave only part of the new module state installed.
cases.useful_review_or_separation: Consider computing next definitions/scope first and then committing the module fields together, if caller behavior requires the closure to remain reusable after error. This is a concrete state-transition seam.
cases.limits: Need caller/error-lifetime evidence before changing order: if the traversal is always abandoned on Err, current partial updates may be harmless.

cases.source_rationale: select_copies performs selected::verify before assigning the resulting copies/no_drop/requirements fields. Fallible selection and state commit are already separated.
cases.useful_review_or_separation: This is a useful example of an existing prepare-then-install seam; the three assignments are a coherent commit.
cases.limits: A raw density score does not show that these fields should be split or written through another helper.

cases.source_rationale: install_binding updates bindings and scope before checking whether a lexical frame exists. A missing frame returns Err after those first updates.
cases.useful_review_or_separation: Review checking the frame precondition before updating the coordinated binding/scope/frame state; this is a small concrete improvement candidate rather than a new subsystem.
cases.limits: It may be an unreachable invariant and callers may discard Flow on Err. Validate that contract before claiming an observable failure or changing semantics.

cases.source_rationale: load_bundle is an explicit decode-inspect-build-validate pipeline, with diagnostics around each phase and a caller-supplied inspection callback. These phases are already separated into helpers.
cases.useful_review_or_separation: Assess whether any finding represents application work, diagnostic output or arbitrary callback effects before proposing an extraction. The visible function is an orchestration boundary.
cases.limits: The callback effect contract and validation internals are not given by the snippet; source alone cannot rank this finding as a useful refactor target.

cases.source_rationale: install_dependency_owners computes linked dependencies then installs namespace association rows for the same dependency graph. These are the two outputs of one installation operation.
cases.useful_review_or_separation: The fallible dependency computation already precedes the infallible mapping/collection; further extraction is not motivated by the writes alone.
cases.limits: Allocation failure is not treated as a new domain error; no hypothetical transactional requirement is inferred.

cases.source_rationale: The constructor proof installer first performs a fallible dependency installation, then records the corresponding product instance. Installing a checked record is its named responsibility.
cases.useful_review_or_separation: The existing install_dependency helper provides the visible separation. No independent responsibility is exposed by the final assignment.
cases.limits: Atomicity of install_dependency itself needs its own caller/source review; the snippet does not prove a defect.

cases.source_rationale: seal invokes the publication callback through a recorder, flushes it, then returns the checksum and byte count of the completed stream. IO and recorder state are the operation itself.
cases.useful_review_or_separation: This is already an explicit streaming/publication boundary. Preserve the final-flush-before-manifest sequence; no score-driven extraction is justified here.
cases.limits: This review recommends no hash change, new hash, policy gate or extra validation. It evaluates source organization only.
